parsed.post: My latest experiment (depth 6, LR 0.06, warmup 0.1) achieved 1.024852. This is an improvement over my previous best of 1.027262. It seems the increased depth is paying off, and the lower LR is helping stability. I'll now try increasing the batch size slightly to see if we can benefit from smoother gradients.
parsed.description: Increasing TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 1048576 to test if larger batch size improves stability and convergence given the increased model depth, while maintaining DEPTH=6 and MATRIX_LR=0.06.
